# Security Incident Response: Diagrams & State Machines

## Incident State Machine

The workflow implements a **5-state incident lifecycle** with clear transitions and exit conditions:

```
                    ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                    │  1. DETECTION & TRIAGE             │
                    │  (T+0 to T+6 minutes)              │
                    │  ├─ Alert ingestion                │
                    │  ├─ Threat classification          │
                    │  ├─ Severity scoring               │
                    │  └─ Threat intelligence enrichment │
                    └──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                                   │
                          ┌────────▼─────────┐
                          │  Severity Score  │
                          │     0-10?        │
                          └────┬──────┬──────┘
                               │      │
                        P1-P3  │      │  P4
                        (≥5)   │      │  (<5)
                               │      │
                               │      └─────────┐
                               │                │
                    ┌──────────▼──────────┐  ┌──▼──────────────┐
                    │ 2. ESCALATION       │  │ Archive Low Risk│
                    │ (if P1 only)        │  │ (No further     │
                    │ T+7 min             │  │  action)        │
                    │ ├─ PagerDuty alert  │  └─────────────────┘
                    │ ├─ Slack notify     │
                    │ ├─ Email CISO       │
                    │ └─ Wait 5 min ack   │
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
                    ┌──────────▼──────────┐
                    │  3. RESPONSE        │
                    │  T+8 to T+14 min    │
                    │  ├─ Containment     │
                    │  ├─ Forensics       │
                    │  └─ Auto-remediate  │
                    │  (Parallel actions) │
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
                    ┌──────────▼──────────┐
                    │ 4. RECOVERY         │
                    │ T+15 to T+32 min    │
                    │ ├─ System restore   │
                    │ ├─ Service validate │
                    │ └─ Monitoring on    │
                    │ (Sequential)        │
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
                    ┌──────────▼──────────┐
                    │ 5. POST-INCIDENT    │
                    │ T+35 to T+55 min    │
                    │ ├─ Timeline build   │
                    │ ├─ Root cause       │
                    │ └─ Report generation│
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
                    ┌──────────▼──────────┐
                    │ ✅ RESOLVED        │
                    │ MTTR = 32 minutes   │
                    └────────────────────┘
```

## Incident Investigation Flow

Detailed flow of the **TRIAGE** phase with parallel agent execution and decision points:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       ALERT TRIGGERED (T+0)                          │
│                    (SIEM, EDR, IDS, External API)                    │
└────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────┘
                             │
        ┌────────────────────▼────────────────────┐
        │   HOOK: Alert-Ingestion (1 min)        │
        │  ├─ Parse alert JSON/XML               │
        │  ├─ Normalize to standard schema       │
        │  ├─ Deduplicate (same incident?)       │
        │  └─ Extract context (host, IP, user)   │
        └────────────────┬─────────────────────┬─┘
                         │                     │
                         ▼                     ▼
        ┌───────────────────────┐  ┌───────────────────────┐
        │ AGENT: Classifier     │  │ AGENT: Severity-Ana. │
        │ (2 minutes)           │  │ (2 minutes)           │
        │ ├─ Threat category    │  │ ├─ Asset criticality  │
        │ ├─ Attack vector      │  │ ├─ Exploit available? │
        │ └─ Malware family?    │  │ ├─ Data sensitivity   │
        │                       │  │ └─ Lateral movement?  │
        └───────┬───────────────┘  └──────────┬────────────┘
                │                             │
                │                    ┌────────▼────────┐
                │                    │ CONTEXT-ENRICHER│
                │                    │ (3 minutes)     │
                │                    │ ├─ MCP: VT      │
                │                    │ ├─ MCP: MITRE   │
                │                    │ ├─ MCP: OTX     │
                │                    │ └─ CVE lookup   │
                │                    └────────┬────────┘
                │                             │
                └──────────────┬──────────────┘
                               │
        ┌──────────────────────▼──────────────────────┐
        │  HOOK: Enrichment (T+5 min)                │
        │  Combine outputs:                          │
        │  ├─ Threat profile JSON                    │
        │  ├─ IOCs list (IPs, domains, hashes)      │
        │  ├─ CVEs + CVSS scores                     │
        │  ├─ TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT&CK           │
        │  └─ Threat actor profile (if known)        │
        └──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                               │
        ┌──────────────────────▼──────────────────────┐
        │  HOOK: Severity-Decision (T+6 min)         │
        │  Calculate score using formula:             │
        │  Score = (criticality×2.5) + (exploit×2)    │
        │        + (sensitivity×2) + (lateral×1.5)    │
        │                                             │
        │  Routes to:                                 │
        │  ├─ P1 CRITICAL (9-10) → Escalate         │
        │  ├─ P2 HIGH (7-8.9) → Slack notify        │
        │  ├─ P3 MEDIUM (5-6.9) → Create ticket     │
        │  └─ P4 LOW (0-4.9) → Archive              │
        └──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                               │
              ┌────────────────▼────────────────┐
              │  P1? (Score ≥ 9)               │
              └────┬──────────────────┬────────┘
                  YES                 NO
                   │                  │
        ┌──────────▼─────────────┐    │
        │ HOOK: Escalation       │    │
        │ (T+7 min, 5min max)    │    │
        │ ├─ PagerDuty alert     │    │
        │ ├─ Slack critical msg  │    │
        │ ├─ Email CISO          │    │
        │ └─ Wait for ack        │    │
        │    (timeout=proceed)   │    │
        └──────────┬─────────────┘    │
                   │                  │
                   └────────┬─────────┘
                            │
        ┌───────────────────▼──────────────────┐
        │  SUBCOMMAND: Response (T+8)         │
        │  (Continue to CONTAINMENT phase)    │
        └───────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Parallel Containment Actions

Shows how **3 containment agents execute simultaneously** with forensics collection:

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    SUBCOMMAND: Containment-Actions (T+8, parallel: 1 min each)  │
└──────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────┬────────┘
           │                                              │
    ┌──────▼──────────────┐   ┌────────────────────┐    │
    │ Firewall-Blocker    │   │ EDR-Isolator       │    │
    │ (1 min)             │   │ (1 min)            │    │
    │ ├─ Parse IOCs       │   │ ├─ Get host list   │    │
    │ ├─ Block at edge    │   │ ├─ Network isolate │    │
    │ ├─ MCP: Palo Alto   │   │ ├─ CrowdStrike API │    │
    │ └─ Log rules        │   │ └─ Verify isolated │    │
    └──────┬──────────────┘   └────────┬───────────┘    │
           │                           │                │
           │                    ┌──────▼───────────────┐│
           │                    │ IAM-Disabler        ││
           │                    │ (1 min)             ││
           │                    │ ├─ Get user list    ││
           │                    │ ├─ Disable accounts ││
           │                    │ ├─ MCP: Okta/AD     ││
           │                    │ └─ Revoke sessions  ││
           │                    └──────┬───────────────┘│
           │                          │                │
           └───────────┬──────────────┘                │
                       │                              │
        ┌──────────────▼──────────────┐               │
        │ AGENT: Forensics-Collector  │◄──────────────┘
        │ (5 min, parallel with above)│
        │ ├─ Memory dump              │
        │ ├─ Disk image               │
        │ ├─ Network traffic (PCAP)   │
        │ ├─ Event logs (Windows/sys) │
        │ ├─ MCP: SIEM (Splunk)       │
        │ └─ Archive to secure storage│
        └──────────────┬──────────────┘
                       │
        ┌──────────────▼──────────────────────┐
        │ HOOK: Auto-Remediation (T+8-9)     │
        │ ├─ Commit firewall rules            │
        │ ├─ Confirm host isolation effective │
        │ ├─ Verify user accounts disabled    │
        │ ├─ Log all actions (audit trail)    │
        │ └─ Set incident status=CONTAINED    │
        └──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                       │
        ┌──────────────▼──────────────────────┐
        │ HOOK: Threat-Neutralized (T+14)    │
        │ ├─ Verify no lateral movement       │
        │ ├─ Check C2 callbacks ceased         │
        │ ├─ Confirm isolation effective      │
        │ └─ Proceed to RECOVERY phase        │
        └────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Escalation Decision Tree

Hierarchical escalation for **P1 incidents** with approval paths:

```
                    Incident Detected
                           │
                    Score ≥ 9 (P1)?
                      /    │    \
                    YES    NO    ...
                     │
        ┌────────────▼────────────┐
        │ ESCALATION TRIGGERED    │
        │ (5 minute timer starts) │
        └────────────┬────────────┘
                     │
        ┌────────────▼────────────────────────┐
        │ PARALLEL NOTIFICATIONS:             │
        │ 1. PagerDuty critical alert         │
        │    (Triggers on-call SOC responder) │
        ├─ 2. Slack #security-incidents      │
        │    (Instant team notification)     │
        ├─ 3. Email CISO + SecOps Lead       │
        │    (Executive awareness)           │
        └────────────┬─────────────────────┬──┘
                     │ Waiting (max 5 min) │
             ┌───────▼────────┐   ┌────────▼─────────┐
             │ Human Approved?│   │  Timeout (5 min)?│
             └┬────────────┬──┘   └────────┬─────────┘
          YES │   NO       │               │ (auto-proceed)
             │             │               │
     ┌───────▼─────┐   ┌──▼──────────┐  ┌─▼──────────────┐
     │ Proceed with│   │ ESCALATE to │  │ Auto-Proceed   │
     │ Auto-Contain│   │ External IR │  │ (Logged)       │
     │ (Logged)    │   │ Team        │  │                │
     └───────┬─────┘   └──┬──────────┘  └─┬──────────────┘
             │            │               │
             └────────┬───┴───────────────┘
                      │
        ┌─────────────▼──────────────┐
        │ Response Phase Continues   │
        │ (Containment executes)     │
        └────────────────────────────┘
```

## Incident Timeline (Complete)

Visual representation of **incident progression** from T+0 to resolution:

```
TIME        EVENT                                       STATUS
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

T+0 min     Alert Triggered (SIEM, EDR, IDS)
            └─ HOOK: Alert-Ingestion                   TRIAGE ▶

T+1 min     Normalize alert, extract IOCs
            └─ 3 agents launched (parallel)            ENRICHMENT

T+2 min     Classifier, Severity-Analyzer, Context-
            Enricher executing in parallel

T+3 min     Threat Intel queries (VT, MITRE, OTX)
            └─ MCP lookups in progress

T+5 min     HOOK: Enrichment (combine outputs)
            └─ Threat profile complete

T+6 min     HOOK: Severity-Decision                     SCORING
            └─ Score: 9.5/10 → P1 CRITICAL

T+7 min     HOOK: Escalation (P1 only)                  ESCALATION
            ├─ PagerDuty alert sent
            ├─ Slack notification: #security-incidents
            └─ Email to CISO
            └─ Waiting for human ack (max 5 min)

T+8 min     SUBCOMMAND: Response
            └─ SUBCOMMAND: Containment-Actions
               ├─ Firewall-Blocker (launching)
               ├─ EDR-Isolator (launching)
               └─ IAM-Disabler (launching)           CONTAINMENT ▶
            └─ AGENT: Forensics-Collector (launching)

T+9 min     All 3 containment agents executing
            ├─ IPs being blocked (Palo Alto)
            ├─ Hosts being isolated (CrowdStrike)
            └─ Users being disabled (Okta)

T+13 min    Forensics collection complete
            ├─ Memory dump: 256GB
            ├─ Disk image: 2TB (compressed)
            ├─ Network traffic: 500MB PCAP
            └─ Event logs: 50MB

T+14 min    HOOK: Auto-Remediation
            ├─ Firewall rules committed
            ├─ Host isolation verified
            ├─ User accounts confirmed disabled
            └─ Incident status = CONTAINED

T+14 min    HOOK: Threat-Neutralized                   VERIFICATION
            ├─ No lateral movement detected
            ├─ C2 callbacks ceased
            └─ Containment effective

T+15 min    SUBCOMMAND: Recovery                       RECOVERY ▶
            └─ AGENT: System-Restorer
               └─ Restoring from clean backup (T-7 days)

T+25 min    System restored, running basic checks

T+28 min    AGENT: Service-Validator                   VALIDATION
            ├─ Database: ✓ Healthy
            ├─ Web servers: ✓ Responsive
            ├─ APIs: ✓ All endpoints responding
            └─ No anomalies detected

T+30 min    AGENT: Monitoring-Activator
            └─ Enhanced logging enabled (threat hunting)

T+32 min    HOOK: Service-Validation
            ├─ All systems healthy ✓
            ├─ No anomalous activity ✓
            └─ Proceed to post-incident analysis

T+35 min    SUBCOMMAND: Post-Incident                  POST-INCIDENT ▶
            ├─ AGENT: Timeline-Generator
            │  └─ Reconstructing attack timeline
            ├─ AGENT: Root-Cause-Analyzer
            │  └─ Analyzing vulnerability exploited
            └─ AGENT: Report-Writer
               └─ Generating executive summary

T+45 min    Timeline reconstruction complete:
            ├─ T+0 min: Initial breach (web shell upload)
            ├─ T+15 min: Lateral movement detected
            ├─ T+30 min: Database compromise attempted
            └─ T+40 min: Data exfiltration started

T+50 min    Root cause identified: CVE-2024-1234
            ├─ Unpatched web server (4.3 → patched to 4.5)
            ├─ Missing WAF rules
            └─ Weak file upload validation

T+55 min    Report complete and approved
            ├─ Executive summary: 1 page
            ├─ Technical details: 5 pages
            ├─ Recommendations: 8 items
            └─ IOCs: 12 IPs, 5 domains, 3 hashes

T+56 min    Tickets created for remediation:
            ├─ Apply CVE-2024-1234 patch
            ├─ Deploy WAF rules
            ├─ Implement file upload validation
            └─ Retrain developers

T+57 min    IOCs shared with:
            ├─ CISA (US critical infrastructure)
            ├─ FBI (IC3 sharing)
            └─ Industry threat feeds

✅ INCIDENT RESOLVED (T+55 min from initial alert)
MTTR = 32 minutes (T+0 → T+32 services restored)
```

## Decision Point Outcomes

Shows how different severity scores lead to different incident handling:

```
Alert Triggered → Score Calculated
         │
         └─────────────────────────────────────┐
                                                │
         ┌──────────────────────────┐           │
         │ SCORE 9-10 (P1 CRITICAL) │◄──────────┘
         └──────────────┬───────────┘
                        │
        ┌───────────────▼──────────────┐
        │ ESCALATION HOOK TRIGGERED    │
        │ ├─ PagerDuty (ASAP)         │
        │ ├─ Slack (ASAP)             │
        │ ├─ Email (ASAP)             │
        │ └─ Wait for human ack       │
        │    (timeout = auto-proceed) │
        │                             │
        │ MTTR SLA: 30 minutes        │
        │ Containment: AUTO           │
        │ Resources: 1 SOC + AI       │
        └─────────────────────────────┘


         ┌──────────────────────────┐
         │ SCORE 7-8.9 (P2 HIGH)    │◄──────────┐
         └──────────────┬───────────┘           │
                        │                       │
        ┌───────────────▼──────────────┐        │
        │ SLACK NOTIFICATION           │        │
        │ ├─ #security-incidents       │        │
        │ ├─ No email escalation       │        │
        │ └─ No human approval needed  │        │
        │                             │        │
        │ MTTR SLA: 2 hours           │        │
        │ Containment: AUTO           │        │
        │ Resources: AI only          │        │
        └─────────────────────────────┘        │
                                                │
         ┌──────────────────────────┐           │
         │ SCORE 5-6.9 (P3 MEDIUM) │◄──────────┤
         └──────────────┬───────────┘           │
                        │                       │
        ┌───────────────▼──────────────┐        │
        │ CREATE JIRA TICKET           │        │
        │ ├─ Assign to SOC queue       │        │
        │ ├─ Low priority              │        │
        │ └─ No automated action       │        │
        │                             │        │
        │ MTTR SLA: 8 hours           │        │
        │ Containment: MANUAL          │        │
        │ Resources: SOC analyst       │        │
        └─────────────────────────────┘        │
                                                │
         ┌──────────────────────────┐           │
         │ SCORE 0-4.9 (P4 LOW)     │◄──────────┘
         └──────────────┬───────────┘
                        │
        ┌───────────────▼──────────────┐
        │ ARCHIVE FOR TREND ANALYSIS   │
        │ ├─ No immediate action       │
        │ ├─ Bulk review later         │
        │ └─ No escalation             │
        │                             │
        │ MTTR SLA: 24 hours          │
        │ Containment: NONE           │
        │ Resources: NONE             │
        └─────────────────────────────┘
```

## Recovery State Diagram

Sequential recovery phase with **parallel forensics** collection:

```
START (T+15 min)
     │
     ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ AGENT: System-Restorer       │
│ (Sequential, 10 min)         │
│ ├─ Identify clean backup     │
│ │  (pre-incident snapshot)   │
│ ├─ Restore full system       │
│ │  (from backup)             │
│ ├─ Verify restore integrity  │
│ │  (hash checks)             │
│ └─ Clear quarantine/isolation│
│    (but keep monitoring on)  │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
               ▼
        ┌──────────────┐
        │ Restored but │
        │ offline?     │
        └──┬─────────┬─┘
         YES        NO
          │          │
    ┌─────▼──┐  ┌────▼──────┐
    │ Run     │  │ Skip      │
    │ FSCKs  │  │ file check│
    └─────┬──┘  └────┬──────┘
          │         │
          └────┬────┘
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ AGENT: Service-Validator     │
│ (Parallel, 5 min)            │
│ ├─ Start critical services   │
│ ├─ Test connectivity         │
│ │  (internal & external)     │
│ ├─ Verify no errors/alerts   │
│ └─ Check: database sync,     │
│    queue processing,         │
│    cache warmup, etc.        │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
     ┌─────────▼─────────┐
     │ All services OK?  │
     └─┬─────────────┬───┘
      YES            NO
       │              │
       │         ┌────▼────────┐
       │         │ Rollback    │
       │         │ (retry from │
       │         │ backup)     │
       │         └────┬────────┘
       │              │
       │         ┌────▼────────┐
       │         │ Re-validate │
       │         │ services    │
       │         └─────┬───────┘
       │               │
       └───┬───────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ AGENT: Monitoring-Activator  │
│ (2 min)                      │
│ ├─ Enable threat hunting     │
│ ├─ Activate enhanced logging │
│ ├─ Set baseline anomalies    │
│ └─ Configure alerting rules  │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ HOOK: Service-Validation     │
│ ├─ 30 minutes without anomaly│
│ ├─ All metrics nominal       │
│ └─ Proceed to post-incident? │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
     ┌─────────▼────────┐
     │ Safe to publish? │
     └─┬──────────┬──────┘
      YES        NO
       │          │
       │    ┌─────▼──────┐
       │    │ Continue   │
       │    │ monitoring │
       │    │ (retry)    │
       │    └─────┬──────┘
       │          │
       └────┬─────┘
            │
            ▼
      POST-INCIDENT PHASE
      (Timeline + Root Cause + Report)
            │
            ▼
          DONE ✓
```
